thread:
maya.s: hey team — trying to add my stepchild who moved in from Spain. Placement date 2026-12-10, passport only right now, SSN pending. Can I add them retro to move-in and what docs do you need? Also worried about imputed income for a non-US tax dependent.

trent: congrats on the new household! :partyparrot: short answer: yes, usually a mid-year QLE (change in household). We can request retro to 2026-12-10 if you submit within 30 days and provide required docs.

benefits-ops: docs checklist we need uploaded to Workday Benefits -> Supporting Documents:
```
- court/guardianship or placement letter showing move-in date 2026-12-10
- stepchild passport (front page)
- proof of residency (utility, lease, or school enrollment showing address)
- birth certificate (if available)
- SSN when issued (mark "SSN pending" now)
```

benefits-ops: note on foreign docs: provide certified English translations for any non-English documents. If SSN is pending, enroll now and update later. We'll file the manual mid-year add with the carriers and request retro effective 2026-12-10. Expect carrier response in ~5-10 business days.

maya.s: thanks. On the tax side: my partner isn't a tax dependent and lives abroad. Will the company treat the coverage value as taxable imputed income?

trent: good question — depends on IRS dependent rules. If the stepchild is not claimed as your dependent on your US taxes, the fair market value of employer-paid coverage could be treated as imputed income.

payroll-bot: payroll note: if imputed income applies we'll notify you before payroll posts. Imputed income will show as additional taxable withholding on the next payroll after benefits confirms enrollment. If you want an estimate of the tax impact, DM payroll and we can run a projection.

maya.s: understood. If the carrier denies retro effective 12/10, what's the fallback effective date?

benefits-ops: fallback: carriers usually allow add effective the date we submit the manual request or the first of the following month. If retro denied, we'll add to the earliest carrier-allowed effective date and coordinate payroll reconciliation (catch-up or refund as appropriate). We'll include an "urgent medical need" note if you have upcoming appointments.

maya.s: OK uploading docs now (including translated birth cert). Requesting retro and asking to spread any catch-up over 2 pays if approved.

benefits-ops: received docs (REQ-2475011111). We've opened carrier ticket REF-2475011111 and requested retro to 2026-12-10 and spread catch-up over 2 pays if approved. We'll post carrier response here.

people-ops: quick privacy reminder: redact any unrelated SSNs in uploaded PDFs and use Workday secure upload only.

benefits-ops: update: carrier responded — medical carrier approved retro to 2026-12-10; dental/vision approved add effective 2027-01-01. Payroll: catch-up for medical will be split over 2 pays per your request and post on the next payroll cycle after reconciliation (expected 2027-02-15 pay). We'll update when payroll posts.

maya.s: thank you all so much heart. I'll update with SSN when it arrives. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
